15 native iOS fixes

Small reliability and accessibility improvements in everyday gear workflows. Implemented locally; simulator fixture evidence is separate from live service verification.

What changed, and why

1. Refresh failure recovery

Was

A failed refresh retained rows without an in-list explanation.

Now

Show a warning above retained items with Retry.

2. Refresh progress

Was

Existing rows gave no in-list indication of refresh work.

Now

Show Updating items while keeping rows visible.

3. Pagination cursor recovery

Was

Reset changed the cursor before the request succeeded.

Now

Commit the new cursor only on success; block pagination after a failed reset.

4. Empty-page termination

Was

An empty page with a larger reported total could keep the spinner alive.

Now

Stop pagination when a page returns no rows.

5. Accurate empty-state titles

Was

Filtered Favorites could imply the entire favorites collection was empty.

Now

Say No matching items when search or status filters are active.

6. Empty-state filter recovery

Was

A status-filtered empty list offered no direct reset action.

Now

Offer Reset filters in the empty state.

7. Single search-clear refresh

Was

Clear search started a direct request and a debounced request.

Now

Use the existing debounced search path once.

8. Empty asset tags

Was

The context menu offered copying an empty tag.

Now

Only offer Copy Asset Tag for a nonempty tag.

9. Favorite request serialization

Was

Rapid taps could overlap optimistic writes for one item.

Now

Allow one favorite request per asset at a time.

10. Unavailable family color

Was

Zero available items still used the available-green tone.

Now

Use neutral gray for zero availability.

11. Precise item accessibility dates

Was

VoiceOver rounded due times into days.

Now

Announce the actual due date and time.

12. Stable booking search

Was

Refresh could remove the empty search field while rows remained.

Now

Keep search mounted whenever the retained list qualifies.

13. Stable explicit booking order

Was

Installing an updated booking restored operational sorting.

Now

Preserve the explicitly selected server ordering.

14. Consistent booking accessibility

Was

VoiceOver could call a pending pickup a return due date.

Now

Use the same pickup/due timing text as the visible row.

15. Bulk item counts

Was

Each bulk SKU counted as one item regardless of quantity.

Now

Sum planned bulk quantities plus serialized items.

Verification

  • WisconsinPerformance simulator build-for-testing succeeded on iPhone 16 Pro, iOS 26.5.
  • 33 source-contract tests passed across 10 files.
  • 4 BookingModels XCTest tests and 18 ScheduleVenueName Swift Testing tests passed. Two stale Schedule fixture initializers were updated to compile against current models.
  • Items long-press and Bookings filter/swipe interaction tests passed on iPhone 16 Pro.
  • An 8-second fixture delay reproduced Updating items with retained rows; the captured image was visually inspected.
  • Repository docs verification and git diff --check passed.

Things to know

  • After-only transition evidence: normal before captures are retained alongside this report, but there is no matched pre-change delayed-refresh capture. Normal Bookings captures are byte-identical and do not demonstrate the edge-case fixes. No visual improvement measurement is claimed.
  • Screenshots use the existing local DEBUG fixture API on iPhone 16 Pro iOS 26.5, 402 × 874 logical points, light appearance, with a 9:41 status-bar override. They do not demonstrate an authenticated production session.
  • Failure responses, empty/filter-specific payloads, concurrent favorite writes, zero-availability family data, bulk quantities, and VoiceOver playback were not all exercised end to end. Source checks and native tests cover a subset; these runtime gates remain open.
  • Source snapshots for the two production files are retained before and after. Existing unrelated checkout changes were preserved. No commit, push, TestFlight upload, or production release was performed.
